mapper.insert: INSERT INTO publication_zip_archive ( download_id, requested_by, post_id, asset_uuids, zip_file_path, size_bytes, mode ) VALUES ( #{downloadId}, #{requestedBy}, #{postId}, #{assetUuids,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.board.repository.UuidArrayTypeHandler}, #{zipFilePath}, #{sizeBytes}, #{mode} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, download_id, requested_by, post_id, asset_uuids, zip_file_path, size_bytes, mode, created_at, expires_at, deleted_at, download_count, last_downloaded_at FROM publication_zip_archive WHERE download_id = #{downloadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE publication_zip_archive SET download_count = download_count + 1, last_downloaded_at = NOW() WHERE download_id = #{downloadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, download_id, requested_by, post_id, asset_uuids, zip_file_path, size_bytes, mode, created_at, expires_at, deleted_at, download_count, last_downloaded_at FROM publication_zip_archive WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_at < NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE publication_zip_archive SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_at < NOW()
